properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 implementation available in the shipped crypto provider ring 0.16.9 (Cargo.lock:4331). No application call site found in this tree — Ed25519 is reachable only through the library surface (e.g. TLS stack internals), not through this application's code. Presence recorded; no use to migrate here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 available via ring 0.16.9 (Cargo.lock:4331) — and concretely reachable: rustls 0.16 (the fetch client's TLS stack, hyper-rustls) negotiates X25519 ECDHE for its HTTPS sessions by default. So X25519 is not merely present, it is the key-exchange group of the outbound TLS traffic — harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant. Migration: hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 via a rustls upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the Ethereum protocol hash: block and transaction hashes, Merkle-Patricia trie nodes, account addresses, EVM keccak precompile, RLPx frame MAC, brain-wallet key derivation (accounts/ethkey/src/brain.rs). Fixed by protocol consensus, not changeable by this repo alone. Symmetric, quantum-safe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keystore account encryption (Web3 Secret Storage v3) in accounts/ethstore: AES-128-CTR with a random per-key IV, key derived via PBKDF2/scrypt. Symmetric, PQ-safe; 128-bit effective (post-quantum margin halved by Grover but still adequate).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ethstore KDF chain: password -> PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 -> AES key. PQ-safe symmetric; iteration counts judged separately (ALG-a861135a).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ethstore KDF: scrypt with work parameters defined in accounts/ethstore/src/account/kdf.rs; default for new keystores. PQ-safe memory-hard KDF.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keystore MAC + RLPx MAC, keyed with the KDF/derived secrets. PQ-safe; MAC verification is not the PQ-relevant surface here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EVM sha256 precompile (consensus-defined) and content-addressed IPFS helper. PQ-safe symmetric hash.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EIP-152 blake2b F-compression; bench-only sites but the same primitive is consensus-defined. PQ-safe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hmac crate (Cargo.lock:2162) — HMAC keyed MAC available in the shipped build; used by ethstore (PBKDF2/MAC). PQ-safe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha2 crate (Cargo.lock:4623/4635) provides SHA-256/SHA-256-256 — used for keystore KDF/MAC and IPFS multihash. PQ-safe symmetric hash.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM available in the shipped parity-crypto crate (via ring 0.16.9) as declared in Cargo.lock. No application call site found in this tree (the whisper crate that consumed aes_gcm is not part of this workspace — only CHANGELOG references remain). Symmetric AEAD, PQ-safe. Presence recorded per dependency-inventory policy.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls 0.16.0 (Cargo.lock:4446, deps: ring 0.16.9 + webpki + sct) behind hyper-rustls in util/fetch — the HTTPS client stack for remote content fetching (e.g. updater binary fetches, IPFS gateway content via rpc). No post-quantum key exchange support in this version; default groups are X25519/P-256 ECDHE. Upgrading rustls (>=0.23 with a PQ-capable provider) is the migration path.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls 0.16 offers TLS 1.3 (then-draft) with ECDHE-only key exchange via ring — TLS 1.3 suite names encode no key exchange, but every group rustls 0.16 can negotiate (X25519, P-256, P-384) is Shor-vulnerable. PQ readiness requires a provider upgrade, not a suite change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt crate (Cargo.lock:4514) backs ethstore's keystore KDF; the application's scrypt usage is separately inventoried (ALG-c1f8b585). PQ-safe memory-hard KDF.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.16.9 (Cargo.lock:4331): the crypto provider behind rustls 0.16 (TLS: X25519 ECDHE, AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD, SHA-2, ECDSA/RSA signature verification) and parity-crypto's AES-GCM. ring 0.16 predates all post-quantum algorithms — no ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA, no hybrid groups. Upgrading the provider is the lever for PQ readiness.
